jobs.title: Junior Fund Analyst
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Analyst

**Leargas Capital | Westport, Connecticut**

About Leargas Capital

Leargas Capital ("Leargas") is a boutique alternative asset manager of institutional capital focused on investment opportunities across U.S. and international mortality-linked markets. Based in Westport, Connecticut, Leargas is expanding its entrepreneurial team as the business continues to scale.

The Junior Fund Analyst will support the senior team across asset management, data analysis, AI-enabled process development, and occasional acquisition due diligence. The role offers direct and frequent exposure working with the CEO and senior decision-makers, along with learning how an alternative investment manager evaluates, monitors, and improves their portfolio.

Responsibilities

* Monitor and review active investments, identify key developments, and support asset-management decisions.
* Aggregate and analyze data from multiple sources to maintain risk and performance dashboards and prepare executive-level reporting.
* Help build and implement AI-enabled tools and workflows to enhance asset management and due diligence.
* Assist with diligence on potential fund acquisitions and synthesize findings for senior management.
* Maintain and improve data aggregation, data infrastructure, and analytics processes.
* Effectively manage relationships with external counterparties.

What We're Looking ForQualifications

* Bachelor's degree in finance, business administration, accounting, economics, or a related field; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience; finance internships, applicable coursework, or student investment experience are valued.

Qualities

* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Motivated self-starter who learns quickly, takes initiative, and is enthusiastic to contribute beyond the defined job description.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who is collaborative, personable, and can positively contribute to company culture.

Skills

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a working understanding of investment metrics such as NPV and IRR.
* Balanced skill profile: quantitative skills are complemented by communication and people skills.
* Advanced Excel proficiency required; experience with SQL, Python, VBA, or AI tools is helpful but not required.

Why Join Leargas

* Direct exposure to an entrepreneurial CEO/fund manager.
* Participation in investment decision-making under the guidance of senior management.
* Hands-on experience across asset management, analytics, AI process development, and deal due diligence.
* Small, relationship-oriented team, where everyone's contributions hold meaningful value.
* Substantial opportunity to advance as the business grows.

Salary & Benefits

**Compensation:** $80,000–$100,000 per year + 10% target bonus

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

**Work Location:** In person, Westport, Connecticut

**Education:** Bachelor's degree required

jobs.title: Help Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
**Location:** Central - 115 E 13th Street, New York, NY 10003
  
What You’ll Do
  
Your role as Help Desk Analyst is crucial in resolving customer issues promptly and efficiently, ensuring their satisfaction. As a Help Desk Analyst, you will be the first line of defense for customer inquiries and play a vital role in identifying and resolving a wide range of technical issues.
  
  
**Your responsibilities will include:**  

* Receive and triage customer inquiries through various channels, including phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
* Actively listen to customer concerns and accurately diagnose the nature of technical problems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve various hardware, software, and network issues using established procedures and best practices.
* Provide clear and concise instructions to customers to guide them through troubleshooting steps and solutions.
* Escalate complex issues to senior technicians or other support teams as needed.
* Document customer interactions and resolution steps for future reference and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain accurate records of customer inquiries, issues, and resolutions.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and software updates relevant to the company's operations.
* Participate in ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance your technical skills and knowledge.
* Collaborate effectively with other support teams and departments to ensure seamless customer service delivery.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude while interacting with customers, even in challenging situations.

**You’re a great fit for this role if you have:**  

* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working in a technical support role.
* Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and network principles.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to customers in a non-technical way.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency in using ticketing systems and other relevant tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work efficiently under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Customer-centric approach with a strong focus on delivering exceptional service.

Compensation
  
Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage, prevailing wage, or exempt salary requirements under federal, state and local laws.
  
We Have GREAT BENEFITS!
  
  

* Health insurance through Cigna, including dental and vision, with an option that covers the entire family with minimal employee contribution.
* Generous Paid Time Off!
* 401(k) with Company contribution, even if the employee doesn't contribute.
* And More!

Who We Are
  
  
At HELP USA, we work to ensure that everyone has a place to call home. We’re one of the nation’s largest non-profit homeless services providers and low-income housing developers serving at-risk populations, including families, individuals, veterans, survivors of domestic violence, people with physical and mental health challenges and disabilities, and seniors. With an annual operating budget approaching $150 million and 1400 employees working in nearly 60 programs, we have helped over 500,000 people facing homelessness and poverty to build better lives. We hope that you will consider joining our team in the fight against homelessness.
  
  
EOE. A Drug-Free Workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Summary

* Responsibilities: You will take a leading role across a variety of scientific projects in the Rare Diseases or Value & Access team, using your expertise to deliver high-quality projects and build client relationships. As an early member of each of these growing teams, you will work closely with team leads and other senior colleagues to drive business development, while having opportunities to directly oversee and manage junior team members, supporting their development as we expand our presence and impact in North America
* Salary: $90,000 to $94,000 per year, depending on your qualifications and previous experience (please note that we have established salary bands that are determined by your level of educational attainment to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations)
* Benefits: Discretionary profit share bonuses paid twice per year, hybrid and flexible working options, generous vacation allowance, private medical and dental insurance, 401K plan with up to a 5% employer contribution, life insurance, full funding and study leave for external training and more
* Role Type: Full-time; permanent
* Start Date: We are currently recruiting for candidates who can start imminently. We have monthly start dates available, and you will be asked to state your availability on your application form
* Application Deadlines: While there are no set application deadlines, we strongly recommend applying as early as possible. The role will close when suitable candidates are found
* Location: This role is available in our Boston, MA and New York, NY offices
* **THIS JOB IS A CURRENT VACANCY AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL IT BY THE END OF 2026**

About the Role

Costello Medical is growing quickly through demand from both new and existing clients and we are therefore looking for candidates with prior experience in healthcare consulting who enjoy content delivery, as well as project and client management, to join us as Senior Analysts in our Value & Access and Rare Diseases teams.

**Value & Access****:** The Value & Access team is further divided into our Market Access and Health Economics teams. It plays a crucial role in ensuring new pharmaceuticals and medical devices are reimbursed and accessible to patients by creating evidence-based materials such as dossiers and slide decks, as well as health economic models, that highlight their clinical and economic value

**Rare Diseases****:** The Rare Diseases team plays a pivotal role in overcoming the challenges of limited treatments and evidence for the >10,000 rare diseases that have been identified. By delivering projects from across the service areas on offer at Costello Medical, they emphasize the clinical and economic value of novel therapies within the rare diseases space. Their mission is to generate fresh ideas that enable the rare diseases community to gain rapid access to groundbreaking, often life-extending treatments

Senior Analysts take a leading role across projects and work alongside Team Leads, Consultants, Analysts and Project Coordinators to ensure that they are delivered to an exceptionally high standard in line with agreed timelines. This involves regular interaction with clients over email and in meetings, including providing strategic advice, as well as internally, training and supervising the Costello Medical project team. Senior Analysts are central to the quality of project deliverables and so their role involves the review of work from more junior colleagues, and the provision of constructive feedback.

You will also play a key role in contributing to business development by identifying new clients, writing proposals for projects with new and existing clients, building and maintaining excellent client relationships, and identifying opportunities to provide additional services within existing projects.

You’ll collaborate closely with our experienced Boston-based Team Leads—each with 7–10+ years in the industry—and senior colleagues across North America and globally. This is more than just a role; it’s a launchpad. You’ll be empowered to take ownership, drive meaningful change, and carve out a career path tailored to your strengths and ambitions.

We are deeply committed to nurturing talent and supporting professional growth. High-performing Senior Analysts are encouraged to progress to the Consultant role as they demonstrate readiness, with clear development pathways and ongoing support in place.

**Hybrid Working Policy:** We believe that having face-to-face time in the office holds many benefits and is central to ensuring that the community we have created, where people have a workplace they belong to and feel part of, is never lost. At the same time, we recognize that homeworking can improve work-life balance, reduce commuting times and costs, and provide the opportunity to juggle personal commitments. Therefore, we offer flexible working arrangements that allow our colleagues to work from home for up to half of the time, measured across a 2-week rolling period.

A Day in the Life of a Senior Analyst

To learn more about a typical day for a Senior Analyst at Costello Medical, please click here: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/day-in-the-life-senior-analyst-us/

Career Profile

We offer many opportunities for personal and professional development at Costello Medical. Please click below to read firsthand accounts from our colleagues about their time with the company: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/

About Costello Medical

Costello Medical is a rapidly growing global healthcare agency specializing in medical communications, market access and health economic and outcomes research. At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future.

We believe diverse teams with unique backgrounds, skills and experiences yield more innovative solutions. Our mission is to recruit, develop, retain and engage a diverse, high-performing team. Our business enables bright, committed people working in partnership within an environment that allows each person to achieve at a high level. We commit to encouraging and valuing inclusivity because every partner brings unique perspectives that help us better serve our clients.

**The Summer Analyst Program**

Piper Sandler is currently seeking undergraduate students for our 2027 Investment Banking Summer Analyst Internship Program. Summer Analysts generally work 10 weeks within an industry or product group in Investment Banking and have the opportunity to learn financial modeling and basic analysis of companies and industries, as well as gain an understanding of the dynamics of the capital markets.

The Internship Program includes one week of formal training held near Piper Sandler’s Minneapolis, MN headquarters. Interns will also be invited attend networking events during the program. Our Investment Banking internships are a direct pipeline to our full time Analyst positions for the following year.

**Qualifications:**

* Anticipated graduation date from an undergraduate institution of December 2027 or May/June 2028
* Seeking a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or another business-related field
* Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Leadership and teamwork skills
* Willingness and desire to learn
* Prior to the start of the internship, it is beneficial for interns to have taken finance and accounting courses or self-study. Training will be provided prior to the start of the internship.
* You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

We take pride in providing our clients with thoughtful advice and diligent execution, no matter the economic environment. Our investment banking group partners with corporate clients and financial sponsors to provide advisory and financing services related to ergers and acquisitions, equity and debt capital markets, private placements, restructuring and corporate & venture services. We offer in-depth knowledge and industry relationships in our core sectors of chemicals, consumer, diversified industrials & services, energy & power, financial services, healthcare and technology. Learn more about our investment banking team here.

Piper Sandler values a strong culture dedicated to the emotional and physical well-being of our employees. Learn more about our commitment to our employee’s health and well-being. Learn more about our benefits program and how we are here for our employees and their families today, tomorrow, and beyond.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran or status with regard to public assistance.

jobs.title: Analyst, Audience Insights
jobs.description:
**Analyst, Audience Insights**

Haymarket Media, Inc. is seeking an Analyst to join the Audience Insights team. This position is located in our New York, NY office on a hybrid work schedule; three (3) days in office depending on business needs.

**Job Overview:**

This position will be responsible for compiling regular data reporting and custom audience counts for clients, across our Medical Communications Group (MCG) and Business Media Group (BMG) brands, with a focus on campaigns for MCG. Responsibilities include the preparation of audience requests for targeted advertising programs, and delivery of scheduled and ad hoc reports for digital, events (live and virtual), lead generation, etc.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the intake of target files from clients and ensure timely distribution to the appropriate internal stakeholders
* Generate presale audience counts for MCG and BMG sales team for proposals and RFPs
* Develop custom audience counts for targeted programs for proposals and RFPs, and provide general insights into the audience
* Work with sales support team to understand client needs and use existing tools to come up with applicable data, analysis and insights
* Maintain, create, and distribute reports from internal and third party data platforms for digital programs, live and virtual events, webcasts and podcasts, lead generation campaigns, and social platforms etc. for presentation to external clients
* QA and validate reports by reviewing data from multiple sources to assure clients receive accurate data
* Create and maintain a schedule of weekly and monthly client reports and meet deadlines without fail
* Work with the Data Engineering and Business Intelligence team to develop requirements to onboard new data sources and create visualization dashboards for the business

**Qualifications include:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in related field preferred
* Minimum of one (1), ideally three (3) years of related experience
* Knowledge of digital landscape, technologies and practices
* Self-starter with great attention to detail, as well as strong organizational, time management and communication skills
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong capabilities with Google Sheets, Excel skills utilizing vlookups, sumifs, countifs, and average/max/min
* Willingness and ability to learn other data platforms (Google Analytics, Looker, etc)
* Experience with SQL and Python preferred
* Knowledge of Medical terminology preferred

**What We Offer:**

* A competitive compensation package
* The salary range for this position is $60,000–$80,000. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, skill level, functional and/or industry knowledge, education level, certifications, as well as other qualifications.
* Paid annual vacation, holiday and sick time off
* Comprehensive health plans including medical, dental and vision
* Competitive 401(k) investment options and generous company matching program
* Life insurance
* Commuter benefits
* Employee referral awards
* Tuition reimbursement
* Training opportunities through industry-recognized programs
* A creative and passionate workplace and a fun, collaborative team environment
* Three Week “Work from Anywhere” benefit, to promote work life balance

 **About Haymarket:**  
Haymarket Media, Inc. is an award-winning specialist content and information company. With more than 30 market-leading media brands, Haymarket offers unmatched expertise and insight through balanced, relevant, original content across a spectrum of media channels. Haymarket is home to highly regarded health care professional brands such as The Clinical Advisor, Dermatology Advisor, and MPR (Medical Professionals Reference) among a portfolio of HCP-focused, specialty-specific websites, as well as the esteemed business media titles including PRWeek, MM+M (Medical Marketing and Media), Campaign and McKnight’s Long-Term Care News.  
  
Haymarket Media, Inc. is the US division of Haymarket Media Group. Haymarket Media Group is a privately-owned media, data and information company, shaping a better future with remarkable content for specialist audiences across the world. The company has 1,300 employees across offices in the UK, US, Canada, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Germany and the Netherlands. Haymarket’s portfolio consists of more than 70 market-leading brands including Campaign, Third Sector, What Car?, MyCME and Asian Investor. Through live, digital, print, education, data, tech services, video and audio, Haymarket’s brands inspire, inform and empower clients and communities internationally. jobs.description:
**About Avalere Health**

United by one profound purpose: to reach **EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE**. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

### **About the role:**

The Senior Data Strategy Analyst supports the development and execution of media reporting and measurement initiatives across client accounts. Reporting to the Manager, Data Strategy, this role is responsible for analyzing marketing performance data, developing insight-driven reporting deliverables, and contributing to measurement frameworks that align with client business objectives.

This position requires a strong understanding of cross-channel media performance (digital and traditional), a developing advanced analytical capability, strategic mindset, and the ability to independently manage reporting workstreams while collaborating effectively across internal teams.

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting with accuracy, clarity, and alignment to client KPIs.

* Translate performance data into clear insights and optimization recommendations.

* Support the development and refinement of measurement frameworks.

* Partner with Strategy, Media, Client Services, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams to ensure data integrity and actionable reporting outputs.

* Contribute to Tableau dashboard builds and reporting automation initiatives.

* Assist in integrating advanced analytics outputs (e.g., attribution, incrementality, MMM) into client reporting.

* Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities within campaign data.

* Ensure timely delivery of reporting outputs and proactively communicate risks or blockers.

### **About you:**

* 2–3 years of experience in marketing or media analytics, including experience analyzing pharmaceutical marketing campaigns.

* Strong understanding of digital and traditional media performance metrics.

* Proficiency in Google Analytics and Tableau.

* Familiarity with pharmaceutical marketing measurement tools, such as Crossix, and the ability to interpret their outputs for client reporting and recommendations.

* Working knowledge of tagging systems and campaign performance datasets.

* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint (or Google equivalents).

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Ability to translate complex data into insights for non-technical audiences.

* Organized and able to manage multiple deliverables across timelines.

**What we can offer**

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

jobs.title: Early Careers: Junior Cyber Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Launch Your Career in Cyber Risk Analytics**

Are you interested in cybersecurity, data, and solving complex business challenges? Aon is looking for a Junior Cyber Risk Analyst to join our Cyber Threat Intelligence team within Cyber Reinsurance Solutions. This is an opportunity for recent graduates to build analytical, technical, and business skills while working with experienced professionals in a growing area of risk.

In this role, you'll work with data, technology, and cyber risk insights to help organizations make informed decisions. Through hands-on experience, mentorship, and professional development, you'll build a strong foundation for a career in cyber risk analytics.

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What is Cyber Threat Intelligence and Cyber Reinsurance Solutions?**

As a Junior Cyber Risk Analyst, you will work with experienced team members to analyze data, develop insights, and support projects that help clients better understand cyber risk.

**What You Will Do**

As a Junior Cyber Risk Analyst, you will gain hands-on experience working with cyber and insurance data while developing an understanding of how analytics can support real-world risk and business decisions.

**Support Data and Analytical Workflows**

* Clean, organize, and validate data from multiple sources.
* Support analytical workflows and reporting processes.
* Assist with data matching, quality checks, and automation initiatives.
* Contribute to process documentation and continuous improvement efforts.

**Build Cyber and Threat Intelligence Knowledge**

* Analyze cyber-related data, including vulnerabilities, incidents, and technology dependencies.
* Support research on emerging cyber threats and trends.
* Help develop insights that support cyber risk assessments and scenario analysis.
* Collaborate with cyber threat intelligence specialists and analytics professionals.

**Support Insurance and Reinsurance Analytics**

* Create reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
* Support portfolio and risk analyses.
* Help prepare materials for internal and client presentations.
* Work with colleagues across analytics, cybersecurity, and reinsurance teams.

**Develop Communication and Stakeholder Skills**

* Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Participate in team discussions and cross-functional projects.
* Build relationships across Aon's global organization.
* Gain exposure to client-facing work and business strategy.

**Qualifications**

* College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or another quantitative, technical, or related field is preferred.
* Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

**The Launch Development Program**

Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through:

* On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists.
* Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness.
* Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations.
* Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path.

**What Will Help You Succeed and Grow**

We are looking for candidates who are curious, collaborative, and excited to learn. Additional experiences that may help you succeed include:

* Curious and eager to learn.
* Interested in cybersecurity, data, analytics, or technology.
* Strong problem-solvers who enjoy working with data.
* Effective communicators and collaborative team members.
* Adaptable and comfortable learning new tools and concepts.
* Detail-oriented and committed to producing high-quality work.
* Motivated to build a career in cyber risk and analytics.

**Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.**

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

**Pay Transparency Laws:**
--------------------------

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $82,000 to $89,500 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location.

jobs.description:

**People. Performance. Purpose.**

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Engage with business teams to understand challenges, provide thought leadership, and identify how advanced analytics solutions could be leveraged
* Draw conclusions and make actionable recommendations based on analysis
* Help better leverage, utilize, and instill advanced analytics solutions throughout the organization
* Design and develop advanced analytics solutions
* Ensure that advanced analytics solutions are practical and effective based on expertise and experience
* Develop processes and tools to measure and monitor solution performance and value achievement
* Continually improve existing analytical based solutions.

**Perks You’ll Get:**

  

* Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance
* Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions
* Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills
* Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

**What We're Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Risk Management and Insurance, Business Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

* Strong communication, organization, and time management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

The annual starting salary for this position is between $70,000 – $80,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

**Who We Are:**

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

jobs.title: Actuarial Analyst - Commercial P&C Insurance
jobs.description:
Come join our team!

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry. Fueled and driven by capable, committed people who share common beliefs and values and "bring it" every day, EPIC is always looking for people who have "the right stuff" – people who know what they want and aren't afraid to make it happen.

Headquartered in New York City and founded in 2007, our company has over 4,000 employees nationwide. With locations spread out across the U.S., our local market knowledge and industry expertise helps support our clients' regional and global needs. We have grown very quickly since our founding, and we continue to see growth and success thanks to our hard-working and growth-minded employees.

Our core values are: Owner mindset, Inspire trust, Think big, and Drive results. If these values and growth align with what you're looking for in your next career? Then consider joining our amazing team!

  

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

We're hiring an **Actuary** to build the pricing models behind our property insurance work, as well as working on casualty lines. You'll build, validate, and maintain actuarial and CAT models that tell us what property insurance should cost for our clients, and you'll turn that output into recommendations our brokers can use with risk managers and CFOs. **Current Property experience is preferred but not required; however must have property pricing & modeling experience at some point in career.**

This is a hands-on modeling job. Most of your week will be spent in the data (policy info, exposures, loss runs) building and refining models that help brokers benchmark risk, sanity-check pricing, and advise clients heading into renewal. ACAS is preferred but not required. If you're a non-credentialed actuary with real property modeling chops, we want to talk to you.  
If you like building property pricing models and want to see your work change how clients buy insurance, this one is for you.  
  
**LOCATION:** Hybrid - open to 3 to 5 days a week in any of the following EPIC Office locations: New York City; San Francisco; Seattle.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Build, validate, and maintain the actuarial and statistical models we use to price property risk, both CAT and non-CAT.
* Work with a collaborative group of 10+ actuaries, geographically dispersed, with a core group located in NYC.
* Use those models to produce indicated rates, layer pricing, limit adequacy reads, retention analysis, and TCOR views that feed real placement decisions.
* Get hands-on with the data. That means cleaning up SOVs, loss runs, and policy schedules, and setting up workflows so the next analysis is faster than the last one.
* Turn model output into something a client can read. Think slides, benchmarks, and short written narratives our brokers can put in front of a CFO without translating.
* Sit with producers, property practice leaders, and clients to walk through the numbers, take the hard questions, and help shape program structure.
* Pitch in on new business. Request for Proposals, prospect meetings, and any deliverable where the actuarial story matters.
* Use AI to move faster and to push back on your own work. We expect you to lean on AI tools for the grunt work (data cleanup, first-pass code, drafting client narratives) and to stress-test your models with it: poke holes in assumptions, run sanity checks, and pressure-test results before they go out the door.
* Keep your models documented and auditable so anyone on the team can pick them up.

**TOOLS YOU'LL USE:**  

* Modeling & Simulation: @RISK, ModelRisk
* CAT Platforms: Moody's RMS, Verisk AIR, Archipelago
* Data & Programming: Excel, VBA, Python, R
* Visualization & Mapping: Power BI, Tableau, ArcGIS
* Market Intelligence: S&P Capital IQ
* Presentations: PowerPoint
* AI: Copilot, Claude

You won't necessarily use all of these on day one. But if you've touched most of them, you'll ramp up fast.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**  
Credentials & Technical Skills  

* ACAS is preferred. If you're not credentialed, we'll still seriously consider you with at least 2 years of dedicated commercial insurance pricing or modeling work.
* Real property modeling experience. You've worked on loss development, trend, frequency/severity, CAT load integration, and layer pricing, not just read about them.
* Comfort with big, messy datasets. Strong Excel is table stakes. You also work in at least one of Python, R, or SQL.
* You use AI in your day-to-day. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, whatever fits the job. You know where it saves you hours, and you know when not to trust it.
* You can explain your work without jargon. If you can't get a broker or a client to follow the logic, the model doesn't matter.

Experience & Education  

* 2+ years of actuarial work, with meaningful time spent on property pricing or modeling.
* Bachelors in actuarial science, math, stats, or another quantitative field.
* Brokerage, reinsurance, or carrier-side property pricing experience is a big plus. Bonus points if you've seen how actuarial work actually moves a placement.
* Self-starter mindset. Our property analytics practice is growing fast, and we need people who want to help build it, not just slot into a process.

Domain  

* You understand commercial property: how programs are structured, what a tower looks like, what TIV values actually represent, and the actuarial logic underneath it all.
* You know the major CAT models (AIR, RMS) and how vendor output gets folded into pricing. Hands-on experience is great but not required.
* You've seen benchmarking, limit adequacy work, and TCOR modeling used in real renewal conversations.
* You're comfortable with complex programs: layered placements, quota shares, deductibles, self-insured retentions, and captives.
* You can work across a lot of stakeholders at once: brokers, practice leaders, clients, and the technical team.

  

**COMPENSATION:**

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Precision ABA Therapy is seeking an experienced and motivated **Clinical Director (BCBA)** to oversee clinical assessment and insurance authorization processes for our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services.

The primary responsibilities of this position include conducting initial ABA assessments for new clients, developing individualized treatment plans, preparing and submitting insurance authorization requests, and ensuring timely completion of clinical documentation.

The ideal candidate will have strong clinical assessment skills, extensive knowledge of ABA treatment planning, and experience navigating insurance authorization requirements. This individual will play a key role in ensuring clients receive appropriate services while maintaining compliance with payer requirements, professional standards, and applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Initial ABA Assessments

* Conduct initial ABA assessments for new clients, including comprehensive evaluations of developmental, behavioral, communication, adaptive, and functional skills, as appropriate.
* Complete functional behavior assessments when clinically indicated.
* Develop individualized ABA treatment plans based on assessment findings, client needs, and measurable treatment goals.
* Establish appropriate treatment recommendations, service intensity, and hours based on clinical necessity and assessment results.
* Prepare comprehensive assessment reports and supporting clinical documentation for insurance submission.
* Update treatment plans as required by insurance providers and applicable standards.
* Collaborate with parents, caregivers, and other professionals to gather relevant clinical information and support treatment planning.

Insurance Authorizations & Utilization Review

* Take primary responsibility for the ABA insurance authorization process.
* Prepare, submit, and track initial authorization requests for new clients.
* Complete and submit reauthorization requests, continued-service reviews, and requests for additional treatment hours.
* Ensure all authorization submissions include the required assessments, treatment plans, progress reports, and supporting documentation.
* Communicate with insurance companies, utilization review teams, and case managers regarding pending requests and clinical requirements.
* Monitor authorization expiration dates and submission deadlines to minimize interruptions in client services.
* Respond to requests for additional information and assist with peer-to-peer reviews, reconsiderations, and appeals when needed.
* Maintain accurate records of approved hours, authorization periods, submission dates, and authorization status.
* Review payer specific guidelines to ensure documentation meets medical necessity and coverage requirements.

Clinical Oversight, Session Note Reviews & Treatment Compliance

* Oversee the clinical review of ABA session notes to ensure documentation is accurate, complete, clinically appropriate, and compliant with insurance payer requirements.
* Review session notes submitted by BCBAs, RBTs, and other clinical staff to verify that services delivered align with authorized treatment plans and approved service hours.
* Ensure session documentation includes appropriate descriptions of interventions, client responses, progress toward treatment goals, and data collection, as applicable.
* Monitor compliance with treatment plan requirements, behavior intervention protocols, and individualized clinical recommendations.
* Verify that clinical documentation supports medical necessity and meets payer-specific billing and documentation standards.
* Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or noncompliant session notes and ensure corrections are completed within established deadlines.

**Skills**

* Previous experience as a Clinical Director, Clinical Supervisor, or Lead BCBA in an ABA therapy organization.
* Experience with commercial insurance plans and Medicaid ABA programs.
* Familiarity with functional behavior assessments, adaptive behavior assessments, and evidence based ABA treatment planning.
* Experience with peer-to-peer reviews, insurance denials, reconsiderations, and appeals.
* Experience coordinating clinical intake, assessments, and authorization workflows for new clients.
* Demonstrated experience conducting initial ABA assessments and developing individualized treatment plans.
* Experience preparing and submitting insurance authorizations for ABA therapy services.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assessments, authorization requests, and deadlines simultaneously.

We are looking for a dependable professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities and is committed to helping families access timely, high quality ABA services.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lakewood, NJ 08701

jobs.description:
What We Need
  
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Credit Analyst for Funds and Corporate within our Credit division. This position falls under our Cambridge line of business and is located in Toronto, Canada. This hybrid role combines institutional fund underwriting with corporate credit analysis, offering a unique opportunity to assess diverse client segments. In this role, you will be responsible for underwriting Funds (FI) clients, performing corporate credit underwriting, and ensuring adherence to the Company’s underwriting standards and risk policies. You will regularly collaborate with key business partners across Sales, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and Operations. You will report directly to the Head of Group Credit and regularly collaborate with your team and other departments.
  
  
How We Work
  
As a Credit Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  

* This will be a hybrid position with an assigned workspace in the Toronto office.
* Company-issued equipment

Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

* Performing underwriting for Fund (FI) clients and corporate clients across multiple jurisdictions.
* Assessing and analyzing financial statements, fund structures, management quality, and other credit factors to determine overall risk and creditworthiness.
* Preparing well-reasoned credit recommendations and, where authorized, approving credit within assigned limits.
* Ensuring all underwriting decisions comply with internal underwriting guidelines, regulatory expectations, and risk policies.
* Monitoring existing portfolios to ensure ongoing compliance and identify emerging risks.
* Conduct portfolio analyses to identify concentration risks, performance trends, and credit deterioration.
* Developing and recommending remediation plans for higher-risk exposures.
* Preparing clear, comprehensive credit memos, portfolio reviews, and presentations for senior management.
* Working closely with Sales, Compliance, Legal, Operations, IT, Treasury, and Finance to ensure seamless deal execution and alignment with risk objectives.
* Supporting Credit Manager with risk-related decisions, exceptions, and complex deal structures.
* Staying current on industry trends, market conditions, regulatory developments, and macroeconomic events impacting credit risk.
* Recommending improvements to underwriting processes, tools, and best practices to enhance risk assessment quality and operational efficiency.

* Minimum of 2+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business Administration (Master’s preferred).
* Professional designations such as CFA, CA, or FRM are strong assets.
* Proven experience in underwriting and credit risk management, ideally covering both Funds (FI) and corporate clients.
* Experience with regulatory compliance in underwriting and a strong understanding of legal and compliance considerations related to Fund structures.

* Excellent financial analysis, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

Why join this team:

Support the implementation and maintenance of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework in alignment with strategic objectives and regulatory requirements. Assist with ERM programs, including Issue Management, RCSA activities, process mapping, risk assessments, and control development. Maintain ERM documentation, support audits and examinations, and analyze key risk indicators (KRIs) and assessment results to deliver actionable insights and reports for the ERM Department and governance committees.

This position is hybrid.

NYC Salary Range - $110,000 - $130,000 annually; compensation is commensurate to geographic location.

What you'll do:

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Regardless of seniority or role, uphold UNFCU’s mission, core values, and guiding principles by providing an exceptional service experience to colleagues and members alike through consistent demonstration of our service excellence behaviors.
* Support the ERM Framework and associated documentation to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements, with primary responsibility for Risk and Control Self Assessments (RCSA).
* Facilitate comprehensive risk assessments, summarize results, and advise on risk mitigation strategies.
* Develop reporting, including managing underlying data point and analysis.
* Stay current with industry updates, new regulations, and best practices in risk management to maintain the effectiveness of the ERM Framework and alignment with regulatory expectations and industry benchmarks.

**Risk Programs**:

* Support Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), including risk and control data management, validation, and maintenance of risk taxonomies, control inventories, and GRC documentation.
* Conduct control assessments and process mapping activities to evaluate control effectiveness, identify key risks, and strengthen internal control environments.
* Monitor and track remediation efforts for control deficiencies and risk issues, ensuring timely resolution and accountability.
* Support the full Issue Management lifecycle, including issue intake, remediation tracking, inventory maintenance, and stakeholder reporting.

**Data Analysis and Risk Reporting**:

* Collect, analyze, and interpret risk-related data to identify trends, anomalies, and areas of concern; develop and maintain risk reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, including senior management and the Risk Management Committee (RMC), to support effective risk mitigation.
* Monitor, track, and maintain underlying data for KRIs and KPIs within areas of responsibility.
* Respond promptly to management requests for ad-hoc analysis and reporting to support decision-making and risk oversight.

**Collaboration and Communication**:

* Partner with the First Line of Defense to advance key risk initiatives and support effective day-to-day risk management activities.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships while developing risk committee materials, presentations, and training resources to promote a risk-aware culture and adherence to the ERM Framework.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.
* Ensure compliance with federal and state laws and regulations and UNFCU’s Code of Ethics & Business Conduct.

What we're seeking:

* Bachelor’s degree or Associate’s degree with equivalent experience.
* 3-5 years of experience in financial services, risk management, internal audit, compliance or a related field.
* Experience with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks and practices, RCSA and Issue Management programs, and operational risk management preferred.
* Experience with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems (e.g., Archer, Quantivate)

What makes you stand out:

**Position Summary**

The Financial Analyst manages accounting and financial reporting for an assigned portfolio of condominium and cooperative communities throughout New York City, typically consisting of 30 or more buildings. This role prepares accurate and timely monthly and annual financial statements, develops budgets and cash flow projections, and provides analysis to support each community’s financial goals.

Working closely with property managers and board members, the Financial Analyst serves as a key financial resource, explaining financial results, responding to inquiries, and supporting informed decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Accounting and Financial Reporting*

* Manage general ledger accounting for an assigned portfolio of condominium and cooperative properties.
* Prepare and review monthly and annual financial statements, including supporting schedules and reports.
* Review general ledgers and trial balances, investigate discrepancies, and prepare necessary journal entries and adjustments.
* Apply the appropriate accounting basis for each property, including accruals and other adjustments where applicable.
* Prepare custom financial reports and cash flow projections to support property-level planning.

*Budgeting and Financial Analysis*

* Prepare annual operating budgets in collaboration with property managers and board members.
* Analyze budget-to-actual results, investigate variances, and provide clear explanations to property managers and boards.

* Serve as a financial point of contact for property managers, board treasurers, and board presidents.

* Coordinate the investment of client funds in accordance with board direction and established procedures.

* Review financial records for properties transitioning to AKAM to confirm required documentation is complete and funds are transferred appropriately.
* Assist with annual audits by preparing supporting schedules, providing documentation, and responding to auditor inquiries.

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Two to three years of public accounting experience.
* Two years of financial analyst or property accounting experience in the real estate or property management industry.
* Direct experience preparing and reviewing monthly financial statements for condominium and cooperative properties.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines across multiple properties.

* Experience with BJ Murray or Yardi is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Product Analyst, Content Supply & Understanding
jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

**The team.** Data & Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions.

**The role.** This role supports Content Supply & Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you.

**Mandate.** Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change.

**Core philosophy.** A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

**About you**
-------------

* You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly.
* You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders.
* You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative.
* You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
* You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable.

**You will**
------------

* Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement.
* Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go-to-market analysis.
* Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade-offs explicit.
* Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout.
* Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time.
* Investigate discontinuities and anomalies in content data, and separate real changes in user behavior from pipeline, definition, or instrumentation changes.
* Use AI-assisted workflows to speed up analysis and reporting, document how results are validated, and keep AI tools grounded as definitions change.
* Present findings and recommendations to product, engineering, and executive audiences, including in regular metrics reviews.
* At the Lead level: set analytical standards for the area and mentor other analysts.

**You have**
------------

* 4+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related role for Senior, or 7+ years for Lead, with a record of influencing product or business decisions.
* Experience turning ambiguous, loosely defined questions into analysis that changed a decision, in areas where data is sparse or metrics did not yet exist.
* Experience with opportunity sizing, segmentation, or business and go-to-market analysis, such as market sizing, pipeline prioritization, or ROI modeling.
* Advanced SQL,

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Credit Risk Management reports into Wealth Management Credit Operations group. The team monitors all JPMorgan Global Wealth Management exposures (loans, OTC derivatives, and brokerage margin loans) secured by financial (equities, fixed income, etc.) and other asset types. They manage intraday transactions and exceptions related to secured credit facilities and pledged collateral. The team is also involved in several development projects, manages various reporting and analytical functions, actively partners with program and technology resources to improve platforms/functionality, and represents the collateral function to various risk and control forums. The functions performed by this team are critical to protecting the bank from potential credit losses.

As a **Margin and Collateral Analyst** within the Credit Operations group, you will be expected to develop a deep understanding of the Credit business and all collateral functions, applicable regulations and policies to provide oversight and guidance to this group daily. In this role, you will work very closely with Credit Operations leadership, Risk, Capital Advisory, Bankers, Client Service, Centralized Lending, underwriting as well as technology, compliance and legal personnel to manage collateral and secured or unsecured credit exposure, execute client requests, identify and escalate credit issues, and manage risk.

King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape.

The Financial Analyst is responsible for assisting the Financial Analyst team in the reporting and modeling of financial and profitability data. This includes working with internal business customers to define reporting requirements, building parameter based reports for end-user execution, developing electronic distribution of reports, functioning as a liaison with the financial systems and finance operations groups, and maintaining the balancing and integrity of the firm’s financial system. This also involves identifying and analyzing key performance measures, de-aggregating metrics into their underlying components, engaging in “root cause” analysis to assess changes in metrics and underlying causes, assessing performance against key industry benchmarks and, assessing the impact of various performance improvement efforts and measuring results. The position is heavily involved in compiling data for further analysis and reporting financial metrics to Partners and Senior Management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advance the firm’s electronic distribution of reports
* Work directly with IT to assess data integrity issues across applications
* Map data elements from various sources to target databases
* Perform extractions from the financial system and ensure the data is maintained accurately
* Primary contact within the team to resolve application software problems with vendors or internal K&S IT Helpdesk
* Prepare, or assist in the preparation, of recurring and special management reports/graphs
* Prepare queries across multiple tables/databases to generate data
* Manipulate data in Excel spreadsheets, SQL, or other databases in order to summarize the financial reports requested

jobs.description:
**Our Story**

With over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world's only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. From iconic brands like Sony, Canon, and Nikon to the latest in drones, smart home tech, musical instruments, and pro audio gear, Adorama provides creators with the gear and services they need to bring their visions to life. **What You'll Do**

  

The Inventory Planning & Data Analyst will combine hands-on inventory planning, SQL, business intelligence, and reporting automation to improve product availability, strengthen purchasing decisions, and optimize inventory investment.

Reporting to the Head of Inventory and Demand Planning and working directly with Merchants, you will investigate inventory, demand, and supply issues, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable SKU-level recommendations. You will independently build dashboards and analytical tools, own recurring analysis and replenishment reviews, and follow corrective actions through resolution within established planning policies and purchasing authority.

This role offers direct exposure to initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution, lead time, and excess inventory management, with opportunities to improve how the team uses data and reduce recurring manual work.

Responsibilities:

* Merchant Support and Inventory Decisions
  + Apply established inventory, weeks of supply (WOS), and aged inventory targets correctly when reviewing PO recommendations and inventory health; flag exceptions, recommend corrective actions, and follow through with Merchants.
  + Investigate merchant questions, identify root causes, and provide clear item-level recommendations; track agreed actions and escalate unresolved issues.

* Replenishment and PO Execution
  + Review daily replenishment and PO needs against established inventory and WOS targets, run-rate, lead time, available inventory, open POs, backorders, and demand trends to control purchasing and avoid excess inventory.
  + Validate system recommendations before execution, especially for high-velocity, high-value, long-lead-time items and SKUs with demand spikes or overstock risk.
  + Release purchase orders within approved authority and follow up with vendors on past-due POs, delivery changes, and supply constraints.
  + Monitor backorders and stockout risk; escalate issues affecting availability, inventory exposure, or merchant goals and track corrective actions through resolution.

* BI Dashboards and Planning Analytics
  + Independently build, maintain, and enhance inventory and planning dashboards in Looker, including data preparation, calculated metrics, filters, and reporting validation.
  + Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate sales, demand, inventory, item master, and PO data.
  + Monitor dashboard refreshes and reporting accuracy; reconcile outputs with source data and troubleshoot discrepancies with BI and technical partners.
  + Automate recurring reporting and build exception dashboards that prioritize stockout risk, aged inventory, overstock, backorders, past-due POs, demand anomalies, and data gaps; highlight affected SKUs, investigation priorities, recommended actions, and follow-up owners.
  + Maintain reporting that monitors inventory, WOS, and aged inventory against established targets; verify their correct application in replenishment and PO review, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions for approval.
  + Support approved initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution and transfers, slow-moving and excess inventory reporting, and lead time and customer ETA reporting through data validation, analysis, and follow-up.

* Root Cause Analysis and Planning Data Accuracy
  + Work with Merchants and Item Master to keep planning-related item fields accurate and updated promptly; identify missing, outdated, or incorrect attributes affecting replenishment and reporting.
  + Follow up on item setup and planning feed issues that create inaccurate recommendations, reporting gaps, or poor inventory decisions.
  + Investigate flagged exceptions involving aged inventory, overstock, past-due POs, backorders, planning overrides, unusual demand, and data gaps to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  + Perform root-cause analysis to identify demand shifts, vendor delays, lead time changes, PO timing issues, item setup errors, or execution gaps; recommend practical corrective actions.
  + Account for promotions, one-time sales spikes, new items, vendor transitions, and opportunity buys when evaluating planning recommendations.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Process Improvement
  + Partner with Merchants to validate demand changes, product lifecycle status, vendor realities, and purchasing needs; respond to requests with data-backed recommendations.
  + Coordinate with Vendors, Item Master, Warehouse Operations, Finance, and BI to resolve inventory issues; own related JIRA tickets from intake through closure.

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively, lead workstreams, and influence cross-functional team

jobs.title: Lead Solutions Analyst - Data Catalog
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you ready to lead at the intersection of data strategy, governance, and enterprise technology delivery? At JPMorganChase, we believe that the right data — governed well, delivered reliably, and made accessible — is a competitive advantage. This is your opportunity to shape that future.

As a Lead Solutions Analyst at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Data and Analytics Services team, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the firm's data strategy by designing and delivering enterprise-scale data solutions across the Corporate Technology organization. You will drive the execution of key data initiatives — including the Corporate Data Catalog, Data Lineage, Entitlements, and Data Quality frameworks — while collaborating with engineering teams, senior stakeholders, and Chief Data Officers to ensure high-quality, accessible, and reliable data assets. Your work will directly support the firm's vision of a self-service, fully observable data platform that embraces data mesh and data product principles, enabling domain-driven ownership and consistent data management at scale.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of regulatory technology programs with regulator-reportable commitments, embedding control and evidence requirements into milestone exit criteria to ensure programs remain continuously audit-ready
* Own and operate a single intake and prioritization model across multiple competing senior stakeholder organizations, converting ad-hoc demand into a published, predictable roadmap with accountable delivery cadence
* Drive on-time milestone delivery against committed dates by managing agile delivery rhythms with engineering teams and proactively resolving cross-team dependencies and delivery risks
* Influence and secure engineering capacity and resources from teams outside direct reporting lines, negotiating scope trade-offs directly with Chief Data Officers and senior leadership
* Apply deep expertise in metadata management, data lineage, data governance lifecycle, data contracts, data tiering, and industry catalog standards to shape platform direction and ensure alignment with firmwide standards
* Instrument and analyze platform usage signals to diagnose adoption blockers, re-sequence roadmaps in response, and drive measurable enterprise-scale adoption through roadshows, enablement sessions, and self-serve onboarding materials
* Own the executive narrative for a multi-stakeholder platform, running senior governance forums and reporting milestone and risk status to senior leadership and regulatory and audit stakeholders
* Partner with engineering leads on sprint planning and backlog refinement to ensure roadmap commitments are reflected in sprint scope and delivery risks are resolved proactively
* Advance the firm's data mesh and data product strategy by fostering domain-driven data ownership, enabling self-service data platforms, and treating data as a product to ensure quality and reliability

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on solutions analysis concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Proven track record delivering technology programs with regulatory reporting obligations, including embedding audit-ready controls and evidence requirements into program delivery frameworks
* Demonstrated experience running a structured demand intake and prioritization model across multiple senior stakeholder organizations, with accountability for end-to-end agile delivery
* Experience influencing at the Managing Director level and above, securing resources from teams outside direct reporting lines and negotiating scope trade-offs with senior data leadership
* Deep working knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, data governance lifecycle, data contracts, and industry catalog standards such as DCAT and DPROD
* Proven ability to drive measurable platform adoption at enterprise scale, including diagnosing adoption blockers and leading enablement programs for technical and executive audiences
* Strong executive communication skills with experience owning governance reporting, running senior forums, and framing complex trade-offs for leadership decision-making

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with AI-ready data product enablement and familiarity with data mesh principles and domain-driven data ownership models
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 or equivalent regulator-reportable data governance standards
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams on sprint planning and backlog refinement to align roadmap commitments with delivery execution
* Knowledge of data catalog, data quality, data entitlements, and data retention and destruction frameworks in a large-scale enterprise environment
* Background working within a federated technology organization, coordinating across multiple lines of business or technology domains to deliver shared platform capabilities

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
