jobs.title: Insights & Analytics Lead - North America
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.  
This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.  
Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.  
Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements  
  Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into clear data, analytics, data science and AI requirements, including hypotheses, data needs, analytical methods, success measures and delivery acceptance criteria.
* Challenge and refine requests to ensure the proposed solution addresses the underlying business problem and is proportionate to the value and complexity involved.
* Recommend the right approach for each problem, whether descriptive or diagnostic analysis, reporting and visualisation, predictive modelling, machine learning, generative AI or workflow automation.
* Deliver Hands-On Analysis and Insight
* Frame analytical questions, develop hypotheses, select appropriate methods and validate findings before drawing conclusions.
* Convert analysis into practical recommendations, explaining the business implications, limitations and actions required.
* Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities could improve underwriting effectiveness, portfolio management, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Shape solution concepts and technical requirements, including use cases, user journeys, required data, model or AI behaviour, controls, evaluation criteria and expected business value.
* Rapidly prototype analytical and AI-enabled solutions to test feasibility and value before wider development.
* Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to support model development, testing, validation, deployment and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Ensure solutions are explainable, fit-for-purpose and developed in line with AXIS data, AI governance, security and responsible AI requirements.
* Work as an active member of cross-functional agile delivery teams, partnering closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Technology experts and business product owners.
* Contribute technical analysis, solution design, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing and retrospectives.
* Promote reuse of common data products, analytical methods, models and components across the wider Insights & Analytics community.
* Define and track outcome-focused success measures, using feedback and performance evidence to improve solutions after release.
* Explain analytical and AI concepts in clear business language and build confidence in the appropriate use of data-driven insights.

**Success Measures**  
Success in this role will be measured through:

* Delivered solutions contribute to measurable improvements in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio insight, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Solutions use the right level of analytical sophistication for the problem and are practical, explainable and fit-for-purpose.
* Strong collaboration and trusted working relationships are established across North America business teams, Data & Analytics and Technology.
* Insights and solutions are adopted and used within day-to-day business decisions and workflows.
* Analytical assets, methods and components are documented, reusable and continuously improved.

**About you:**  
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals

As a provider of customized supply chain solutions, we serve customers in many business-to-business market segments including restaurants, grocery stores, healthcare, sports and entertainment, and cruise lines.
  
  
**You will:**  

* Conduct competitive compensation analysis to determine classification and appropriate salary range using relevant market survey data while considering internal equity.

* Proficiency with compensation market pricing and survey tools, including Salary.com CompAnalyst or comparable benchmarking platforms.
* Knowledge of compensation practices supporting both hourly and salaried employee populations across multiple job families and organizational levels.

* Strong technical knowledge of Excel is required, including the ability to develop spreadsheets with formulas, functions, pivot tables, and lookups.

The role will be based in Whippany, NJ with the expectation of a hybrid work model.

**Institutional Client Group:**

The Global Client Group (GCG) is responsible for driving the firm’s strategy and business development efforts with institutional investors and consultants, globally. The Insurance team, part of MetLife Investment Management’s (MIM’s) Global Client Group, oversees $126 billion in assets under management across over 150 insurance clients invested across MIM’s platform in public and private assets, which represents 39% of MIM’s unaffiliated client AUM.

**The Role:**

The Insurance Relationship Manager analyst will be a client facing role, working with Insurance GCG members, investment professionals across Public Fixed Income, Private Fixed Income Real Estate, Alternatives, and other key stakeholders such as MIM’s Insurance Asset Management team to provide proactive, focused client service to insurance clients. The Insurance Relationship Manager analyst will support senior relationship managers on client accounts, often quarterbacking client deliverables and initiatives internally and externally.

**Key Relationships:**

* Reports to: Senior Relationship Manager, Managing Director - Insurance
* Direct reports/team: None
* Key Stakeholders: Global Co-Heads of Insurance, Insurance Relationship Managers, investment and functional support teams across MIM

**Horizon Media** , founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. * A problem solver with the ability to develop creative solutions

jobs.description:
**Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations**
------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Snapshot**

* **Job Title:** Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations
* **Department:** Operations / R&D / Marketing
* **Location:** On-site in Inwood, NY, directly across the Queens border from Far Rockaway and minutes from the Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue A train terminal. In close proximity to JFK Airport.
* **Schedule:** Full-time, Monday-Friday, onsite 5 days per week
* **Compensation:** $95,000-$120,000 per year, based on directly relevant experience, education, and systems expertise.

Rockville is seeking a Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations to help build and run the project management structure behind our R&D, product development, marketing, ecommerce, and cross-functional business priorities.

This is a hands-on project management role for someone who is highly experienced with ClickUp, highly adept at using AI tools and AI agents, strong in communication, and capable of helping a fast-moving business create more structure, visibility, accountability, and follow-through without slowing the team down.

The right person is not simply a task tracker. We need someone who can understand what matters to senior leadership, translate priorities into clear workflows and dashboards, run effective project meetings, follow up assertively across departments, and help teams keep projects moving with less confusion and more accountability.

Rockville is an online retailer specializing in high-quality audio equipment across multiple categories, including car audio, marine audio, pro audio, DJ equipment, recording equipment, lighting, speakers, amplifiers, subwoofers, microphones, mixers, monitors, accessories, components, and related products. Our business moves quickly, with projects running across product development, R&D, marketing, ecommerce, content, data, customer experience, and operations. We need a project manager who can bring structure, visibility, and follow-through to that environment.

Our facility is located in Inwood, NY, directly across the Queens border from Far Rockaway and minutes from the Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue A train terminal. Many members of our team commute from Queens and Brooklyn via the A train.

### **What Makes This Role Stand Out**

* **Project management infrastructure:** Help standardize uniformity of practical project management structure for a growing business, including intake, prioritization, meeting cadence, status reporting, accountability, and executive visibility.
* **ClickUp ownership:** Build, configure, maintain, and improve ClickUp workflows, dashboards, automations, templates, task structures, statuses, custom fields, dependencies, and reporting views.
* **AI-forward project operations:** Use AI tools, AI agents, and automation to improve follow-up, reporting, task organization, meeting notes, project visibility, workflow efficiency, and administrative leverage.
* **R&D and Marketing impact:** Support project flow across product development, R&D, marketing, ecommerce, content, creative, data, and related cross-functional initiatives.
* **Executive visibility:** Translate leadership priorities into simple dashboards and status views that show what is moving, what is blocked, what is late, and what needs attention.
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Work across departments, personalities, and communication styles to keep people aligned, remove confusion, and drive follow-through.

### **What You’ll Own**

* Own day-to-day administration and improvement of ClickUp for R&D, Marketing, and related cross-functional project work.
* Configure and maintain workflows, statuses, task templates, custom fields, automations, dependencies, recurring tasks, dashboards, and reporting views.
* Use AI tools and AI agents to streamline project updates, summarize meetings, organize follow-ups, identify blockers, improve reporting, and reduce manual administrative work.
* Build executive-ready dashboards that show project health, overdue items, blocked work, priority deliverables, risks, missed deadlines, resource concerns, and items requiring leadership attention.
* Manage project intake, task setup, ownership, milestones, dependencies, approvals, follow-ups, status updates, and documentation standards.
* Support R&D projects by tracking product development milestones, testing activity, documentation, handoffs, approvals, blockers, priority changes, and completion status.

jobs.title: Global Technology Strategy, Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Global Technology (GT) organization at JPMorganChase is a world-class technology team of 65,000+ technologists across 20+ technology hubs worldwide with $20B+ in annual technology investment. GT develops high-quality technology products and solutions for JPMC's millions of clients and customers, and 320,000+ employees—everything from employee and infrastructure platforms to big data and mobile solutions, innovations in agentic / generative AI, electronic payments, cybersecurity, machine learning, cloud development, and more.

The Global Technology Strategy (GTS) team is an internal management consulting team that works closely with GT Leadership—the Firm's CIOs, CISO, CTO, and other senior technology leaders—to drive technology strategy, enable innovation, and solve the biggest technology problems across the firm. We work on several types of strategy projects, including problem sizing/solutioning, process reimagination, operating model and organizational design, firmwide transformation, and more, to help JPMC define how technology should be utilized to enable the firm's overall business strategy, including in areas such as AI/agentic, data strategy, technology infrastructure, line of business technology, product development lifecycle etc.

As an Analyst on the Global Technology Strategy team, you will utilize the strategy consulting toolkit—problem framing, critical thinking, analysis and synthesis, executive communication/narrative, stakeholder management, and more—to play a crucial role in defining and deconstructing technology problems for the organization. When someone joins the Global Technology Strategy team, they accelerate their career by working on high-impact and complex problems, learning and applying industry-leading technology practices, and becoming part of a highly collaborative team that prioritizes professional development and ownership.

* Support projects to resolve complex, cross-cutting, executive-level problems faced by the GT organization

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Knowledge of enterprise technologies and trends; ability to learn quickly as the technology landscape continues to rapidly evolve

IRIS Environmental Laboratories is an accredited environmental testing laboratory in Union, New Jersey. We serve environmental consultants, property managers, schools, healthcare facilities, and contractors. We are expanding our metals program and are looking for a senior analyst to own it.

**Position Summary**  
The Senior ICP-OES Analyst leads the lab’s inorganic metals program on an Agilent 5110 SVDV ICP-OES. The role covers drinking water, non-potable water, and solid, wipe, and air-filter matrices under EPA Methods 200.5, 200.7, and SW-846 6010D. You will run and review routine analyses, maintain method compliance under TNI/NELAP and AIHA-LAP quality systems, keep the instrument performing, and train and mentor metals staff.

* Routine experience performing EPA 200.7 and/or 6010 series methods. EPA 200.5 experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with acid and/or microwave digestion of water and solid matrices.
* Working knowledge of TNI/NELAP, ISO/IEC 17025, or equivalent quality systems.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot instruments and resolve QC failures independently.
* Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
* Ability to work on-site in Union, NJ.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Agilent ICP-OES and ICP Expert software.

jobs.description:
We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page!

Our banner is part of Signet Jewelers, a purpose-driven company who believes love inspires love and whose mission it is to enable all people to Celebrate Life and Express Love. Signet Jewelers is also a “Great Place to Work-Certified™” company. Innovation and brilliance – two things that set us apart. Join us!

The Analyst, Supply Chain Planning is responsible for providing the analytical foundation on which our demand, supply, and inventory decisions are made, and for driving the improvement initiatives that advance our planning capability over time. This role sits within the Planning team alongside our demand and supply planners: where they own the execution of the forecast and the replenishment plan, you own the analysis, diagnostics, and reporting that make those decisions sharper, faster, and more defensible. You will build and automate the recurring performance reporting the team runs on, investigate and explain variance rather than simply surface it, and translate large, complex datasets into recommendations leadership can act on. This position offers broad exposure across forecasting, replenishment, and inventory strategy, and a direct path to grow into a planning or analytics leadership role as our team's scope expands.  
  
One of the first tactical initiatives for this role will be building out our store sales performance and replenishment analytics. As our retail showroom footprint grows alongside e-commerce, we need clear visibility into how each location sells, where availability is constraining sales, and how inventory should be allocated and replenished across the network.  
  
You will own the analysis that establishes that visibility and turns it into a repeatable replenishment approach. We are a hands-on, code-forward planning organization. Our forecasting, replenishment, and reporting run on a Python-native analytics stack rather than on manual spreadsheets, and every member of the team is expected to work fluently in SQL, Python, and BI tooling. This is how we operate, and it is central to how this role creates value.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Analytics, Reporting & Performance Management
* Build, automate, and maintain the recurring reporting and dashboards the Planning team operates on, including forecast accuracy and bias, service level and fill rate, inventory turns, weeks of supply, replenishment health, and fulfilment mix Extract, clean, and reconcile data across multiple source systems into trustworthy, decision-ready views, applying disciplined validation before any number is published
* Define and track planning KPIs against target, developing exception reporting that surfaces risk early rather than after the fact
* Investigate variance to root cause and explain the drivers behind it, distinguishing genuine demand signal from data quality, seasonality, and one-off effects
* Prepare the analytical inputs and supporting materials for the weekly planning cycle and the monthly IBP cadence

**Demand & Supply Planning Support**

  

* Partner day to day with the demand and supply planners, providing the data, backtests, and diagnostics required to make better forecasting and replenishment decisions
* Support forecast review by quantifying forecast value add, benchmarking model output against naive baselines, and identifying where statistical output requires human override
* Analyze demand patterns across categories and channels, including seasonality, promotional lift, new product introduction, and clearance behavior
* Model the service level and working capital implications of proposed planning decisions to support tradeoff discussions

**Store Sales Performance & Replenishment**

  

* Build the reporting and analysis that establishes clear visibility into store level sales performance, including sell-through, productivity by location, category mix, and performance against plan
* Analyze store inventory position and availability, quantifying lost sales opportunity where stock outs or thin coverage are constraining sell-through
* Develop and refine store replenishment logic, including model stock, reorder triggers, and allocation rules across locations
* Support allocation decisions for new product introduction, seasonal ranges, and high-demand SKUs across the store network
* Compare demand signal and inventory productivity across store and e-commerce channels to inform how inventory is positioned across the network
* Establish the recurring store performance and replenishment reporting cadence, and evolve it from initial build into standard operating process

**Inventory & Assortment Analysis**

  

* Support inventory strategy analysis across finished jewelry and, as the team's scope expands, component and factory inventory: what to carry, how much, and where
* Analyze inventory health including aging, coverage, excess and obsolescence risk, and availability gaps, and recommend corrective action
* Contribute to assortment and SKU rationalization analysis, quantifying the sales and working capital impact of range changes
* Assess fulfilment method performance across our asset, vendor-stocked, and just-in-time models, and identify opportunities to improve availability and speed

**About Us:**

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** Revenue Integrity Analyst II
  
  
At Memorial Sloan Kettering (MSK), our Revenue Integrity team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate coding, charge capture, compliance, and financial integrity, directly supporting MSK's mission to end cancer for life. The Revenue Integrity Analyst II serves as a coding and revenue cycle subject matter expert, partnering with clinical, coding, and operational teams to optimize charging workflows, maintain regulatory compliance, and strengthen reimbursement outcomes across the organization.

  

**Role Overview**

  

* Serve as a subject matter expert on revenue integrity, charge capture, diagnostic coding, and billing compliance.

* Perform comprehensive reviews of Charge Description Master (CDM) records to ensure coding accuracy, compliance, and ongoing integrity.

* Investigate coding and charging discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement standardized corrective actions.

* Manage and resolve Revenue Integrity tickets related to coding edits, charge capture issues, CDM maintenance, and billing discrepancies while maintaining clear audit trails.

* Partner with Diagnostic Coding teams, including Radiology and Pathology coders, to ensure accurate application of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.

* Evaluate Epic work queues, coding edits, and charge review reports to identify reimbursement risks and revenue leakage opportunities.

* Collaborate with Revenue Operations, HIM, Billing, and Clinical departments on quarterly and annual coding updates and regulatory changes.

* Educate clinical departments and operational stakeholders on coding requirements, charge capture accuracy, documentation standards, and compliant billing practices.

Present coding audit findings, revenue integrity trends, and process improvement recommendations to leadership and governance committees.  

  

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience.

* Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS, charge capture processes, and billing compliance requirements especially related to LCD NCD regulations.

* Professional coding certification required or strongly preferred, including CPC, COC, CCS, RHIA, or RHIT.

* Experience collaborating with coding, HIM, revenue cycle, finance, and clinical teams within a complex healthcare environment.

* Demonstrated experience analyzing coding edits, denials, charge reconciliation issues, and reimbursement impacts.

Epic experience and familiarity with revenue cycle applications, coding work queues, and charge review tools preferred.  

  

**Core Skills**

  

* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to identify coding trends, documentation gaps, workflow deficiencies, and compliance risks.

* Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement methodologies, coding regulations, and revenue cycle operations.

* Ability to communicate complex coding and revenue integrity concepts clearly to clinical, operational, and leadership audiences.

* Proven ability to conduct coding education, training, and audit feedback sessions that drive sustainable improvements.

Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a focus on accuracy, accountability, and continuous process improvement.

**SUMMARY:**

VISIONS/Services for the Blind and Visually Impaired seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – Government Contracts to join its Finance and Administration team. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, the Senior Financial Analyst will have primary responsibility for the day-to-day fiscal management and financial monitoring of VISIONS government-funded programs, with particular emphasis on contracts with NYC Aging and the New York State Commission for the Blind (NYSCB).

The position will work closely with the CFO, program leadership and other members of the Finance team to ensure that contract budgets are accurate, expenditures are appropriately allocated, invoices and claims are submitted timely, and VISIONS maximizes available government funding while remaining in compliance with funder requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial analysis and budgeting skills with hands-on experience managing New York City and/or New York State government contracts and financial systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Government Contract Financial Management

* Manage the fiscal components of assigned NYC and New York State government contracts, with particular responsibility for NYC Aging and NYSCB-funded programs.
* Develop, maintain and monitor contract budgets in partnership with the CFO and program leadership.
* Track actual revenue and expenses against contract budgets and identify variances, underspending, overspending and other issues requiring attention.

Billing, Invoicing and Reconciliation

* Prepare, review and submit invoices, claims and supporting documentation (i.e. salaries, fringe, units of service) for government contracts in accordance with funder requirements and deadlines.
* Reconcile government contract revenue and receivables to the general ledger and monitor outstanding payments.
* Identify delayed or outstanding receivables and work with appropriate internal staff and government agencies to resolve issues.
* Maintain complete and accurate supporting documentation for contract expenses, invoices and fiscal reports.
* Assist with year-end contract closeouts and reconciliations.

Government Financial Systems

* Serve as a key Finance Department user of NYC and New York State government contracting and financial systems.
* Manage financial activities in NYC PASSPort, including contract budgets, budget modifications, invoicing and related submissions.
* Utilize other applicable City and State systems required for VISIONS government contracts.
* Maintain current knowledge of changes to government contracting, budgeting, billing and reporting requirements.

Financial Analysis and Organizational Support

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.  
  
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Housing Access and Stability (“HAS”) consists of the divisions of Housing Opportunity, Tenant and Owner Resources, Housing Stability, Budget and Program Operations, and Program Policy and Innovation. The mission of the office is to ensure fair, efficient, and transparent access to affordable housing. The Office provides subsidies, placement services, and tools that connect New Yorkers to affordable housing and ensures vulnerable households in subsidized housing have the support they need to be safely housed. Housing Access is committed to expanding housing choices, affirmatively furthering fair housing, and stabilizing the financial health of buildings.

The Division of Budget and Program Operations (BPO) within the Office of Housing Access and Stability provides support services to the Division of Housing Opportunity, Division of Tenant and Owner Resources, the Division of Housing Stability, and the Division of Policy and Program Innovation. jobs.title: Equity Research – Analyst/Associate, Airlines & Freight Transportation (New York)
jobs.description:
Research

Morgan Stanley Investment Research is uniquely committed to being an essential part of our clients' investment process. We strive to be the sell-side research provider that best understands the buy side. Through relevant and timely conversations with leading investors, we focus resources on risk-reward essentials: identifying the investor debates, assessing the potential outcomes, and uncovering the evidence our clients need to validate their investment decisions. Our equity analysts cover some 3,000 stocks; our economists, strategists and fixed income analysts cover all major regions and other asset classes around the globe.

  
  

Equity Research

The Equity Research department is responsible for researching macroeconomic and microeconomic conditions, along with company fundamentals. It also collects and analyses financial information to make investment recommendations on stocks in specific sectors. Research analysts build financial models to explore alternative scenarios, examine industries and communicate with companies and investors. Equity Research team members discuss their analysis and investment recommendations in research notes. A career in investment research at Morgan Stanley demands a commitment to excellence and a passion for the markets as well as the highest level of integrity.

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Analyst/Associate member to join our Airlines & Freight Transportation team in New York City.

The Airlines & Freight Transportation research team covers 30+ stocks across airlines, rails, trucking, parcels, and logistics. The team is known for differentiated, out-of-consensus views that balance timely tactical calls with deep thematic research, including work on technology-driven disruption such as autonomous trucks, drones, eVTOLs, and freight digitization, supported by a highly developed data and modeling platform.

  
  

Primary Responsibilities

* Create and maintain financial, valuation, and industry models, leveraging skills in accounting, finance, and economics

* Translate company, industry, consumer, market, and alternative data into insightful research reports with clear investment debates, differentiated conclusions, and actionable stock calls

* Develop and maintain relationships with management and investor relations teams of companies under coverage, industry specialists, and other key leaders of opinion

* Engage with institutional investors by responding to in-depth questions, addressing bespoke requests, discussing companies and investment theses, and helping communicate the team’s highest-conviction views

* Support internal sales and trading teams with timely analysis of sector breaking news and relevant industry developments

* Adopt and apply AI-enabled research tools judiciously to accelerate information gathering, model maintenance, data analysis, and workflow execution while maintaining analytical rigor, source verification, data integrity, and quality control

* Conduct industry diligence and primary research through surveys, expert conference calls, and channel checks to evaluate industry trends and their implications for companies under coverage

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to produce larger industry and thematic reports

  
  

Qualifications

* Ideally 1-2 years of professional experience in equity research or investment banking

* Experience or sector knowledge in airlines and/or freight transportation is highly desirable

* Proven experience using Excel to build and maintain financial models; advanced Excel proficiency is required

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly, defend conclusions, and contribute positively in client-facing discussions

* Demonstrated interest in public markets and a genuine curiosity about what drives stock performance, investor debates, and valuation

* Comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve research efficiency, with the judgment to verify outputs, protect data integrity, and apply tools appropriately

* Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

* Ability to adapt quickly and work well under pressure

* High EQ, strong personal drive, energy, creativity, intellectual curiosity, organizational discipline, and a team-oriented mindset

* Ability to think independently, develop differentiated views, and operate with a self-starter mentality

* Experience with Python is a plus but not required

* CFA designation, or progress toward CFA is a plus but not required

  
  

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citigroup Global Markets Inc. seeks a Systematic Quantitative Analyst for its New York, New York location.

Duties: Perform analytical duties to support implementation of investment, capital raising, hedging, and asset allocation strategies. Perform computerized analysis of sophisticated financial and other quantitative data to be used in developing client proposals and strategic plans, and formulate and apply mathematical modeling and other optimizing methods to interpret this data. Assist in building financial models for trading desks. Develop sophisticated mathematical models for securities valuation, structuring portfolios, and formulating investment and trading strategies. Perform financial product modeling, portfolio structuring, asset allocation, bond market return analysis, systems development analysis, and bond market sector strategy analysis. Organize and analyze complex numerical and statistical data and other variables to develop valuation models and perform in-depth quantitative industry studies. Research and implement bond trading strategies using advanced statistical and mathematical models applied to large-scale bond trading datasets. Utilize programming languages and databases to process, analyze, and extract actionable insights from high-frequency, high-volume fixed income trading data. Design multi-factor credit risk decomposition models for corporate bonds. Design and build comprehensive back testing programs in Python to evaluate the historical performance of trading signals and risk models. Simulate realistic trading conditions in order to produce reliable and unbiased assessments of model performance. Collaborate with traders, technology teams, and risk management professionals to translate quantitative research findings into production-ready trading systems A telecommuting/hybrid work schedule may be permitted within a commutable distance from the worksite, in accordance with Citi policies and protocols.

Alternatively, employer will accept a Bachelor’s degree in the stated fields and 6 years of the specified progressive, post-baccalaureate experience. Full span of experience must include: Developing analytics programs for financial applications using Python or other computer languages; Fixed income products including corporate bonds to build mathematical models for trading and risk management; Developing quantitative trading strategies for credit markets using advanced mathematical, statistical methods and knowledge of financial markets, including corporate capital structure and credit spread dynamics; Credit markets, including market microstructure, to improve trading strategies and credit risk models; Performing large-scale data manipulation and statistical analysis on corporate bond datasets to build sophisticated credit trading strategies; and Analyzing financial datasets utilizing machine learning and statistical approaches to extract significant signals and improve mathematical models and trading strategies. About G20 Group

G-20 Group is a cross-asset trading firm headquartered in Switzerland, trading delta-one and derivatives markets globally. We combine startup agility with institutional-grade experience in proprietary trading, technology, and quantitative finance.

Role Overview

As an expert Research Analyst at G-20, you will be responsible for producing high-conviction, actionable investment research across US equities, with a primary focus on Energy, the "Magnificent 7" mega-cap technology names, and Semiconductors. You will work closely with portfolio managers and traders to translate deep fundamental and thematic research into differentiated investment ideas, supporting G-20's decision-making across its trading and investment strategies.

Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth fundamental research and financial modeling on US Energy stocks, Magnificent 7 names (Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta, Tesla), and Semiconductor companies.
Develop and maintain detailed earnings models, valuation frameworks, and scenario analyses to support investment and trading decisions.
Monitor sector-specific catalysts, including earnings releases, capex cycles, supply/demand dynamics, regulatory developments, and technological trends (e.g. AI infrastructure buildout, chip supply chains, energy transition themes, OPEC+ policy).
Generate timely, well-argued investment theses and actionable trade ideas, clearly articulating risk/reward and key catalysts.
Build and maintain relationships with company management teams, sell-side analysts, and industry contacts to enhance information edge.
Track macro and geopolitical developments relevant to covered sectors (e.g. oil supply dynamics, semiconductor export controls, AI capex trends) and assess their portfolio impact.
Collaborate closely with portfolio managers and traders to size positions, manage risk, and refine entry/exit strategies based on research views.
Present research findings clearly and concisely through written notes and verbal briefings, ensuring key messages are actionable for trading decisions.
Continuously refine coverage frameworks, data sources, and analytical tools to improve research quality and efficiency.

Requirements

Degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field from a top-tier university; CFA or equivalent professional qualification is a plus.
Minimum 5+ years of equity research experience (sell-side or buy-side), with demonstrated coverage of Energy, large-cap Technology, and/or Semiconductor sectors.
Strong financial modeling, valuation, and analytical skills, with a track record of generating differentiated, high-conviction investment ideas.
Deep understanding of the drivers specific to each coverage area: commodity price dynamics and energy markets, mega-cap tech competitive positioning and AI-driven growth narratives, and semiconductor cycle/supply chain dynamics.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into clear, actionable investment views.
Proven ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment, with strong attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating effectively with traders and portfolio managers.

Preferred / Desirable Experience

Prior experience at a top-tier sell-side research firm, hedge fund, or proprietary trading firm.
Established network of industry contacts, management teams, and sell-side relationships across covered sectors.
Proficiency with financial data and analytical tools (e.g. Bloomberg, FactSet, Python, Excel/VBA, SQL).
Experience working closely with trading desks to translate research into position sizing and risk management decisions.

Locations and Right to work
: This role can be based out of our Zurich, London, New York or Hong Kong office. Only candidates who possess the pre-existing right to work in one of the locations above without company sponsorship need apply.

Join G-20 and be a part of a team that is at the forefront of financial markets, driving innovation and excellence in the sector.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About Alphastream

Alphastream is an AI-native technology company transforming how leading private capital firms access, analyze, and operationalize investment data. Our platform combines deep private markets domain expertise, advanced AI, and structured data intelligence to power critical workflows across the private credit investment lifecycle—from origination, due diligence, and deal structuring to execution, portfolio monitoring, and investment operations. Working with some of the world's largest alternative asset managers, Alphastream is building the foundational data and intelligence layer for the next generation of private markets workflows.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with strong private credit domain expertise to work at the intersection of institutional clients, financial markets, and cutting-edge AI technology. This is a highly visible, client-facing role for someone who understands how private credit investment teams operate, can identify opportunities to improve their workflows, and can translate complex business challenges into innovative technology solutions. You will work directly with investment professionals, credit analysts, portfolio managers, legal teams, and operations leaders at leading private capital firms to understand their business needs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making.
A central part of the role involves partnering closely with Alphastream's engineering and data science teams to conceptualize, design, develop, and deliver industry-leading solutions that address complex challenges across the private credit investment lifecycle. You will also play an important role in developing and enhancing Alphastream's private credit taxonomies and data frameworks, ensuring that complex financial and legal concepts are accurately represented, standardized, and operationalized within our AI-powered platform.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Business Solutions

Serve as a trusted domain expert to leading private credit managers, engaging directly with investment, legal, portfolio management, and operations teams.
Develop a deep understanding of clients' investment processes, data requirements, existing workflows, and operational challenges.
Lead client discovery sessions and workshops to identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and AI-driven solutions.
Work collaboratively with clients to conceptualize solutions that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value.
Translate business needs into clearly defined use cases, functional requirements, business rules, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
Support proof-of-concept engagements, product demonstrations, solution validation, and client adoption.

Solution Development & Engineering Collaboration

Partner closely with engineering and data science teams to design and build innovative, industry-leading private credit solutions.
Translate complex financial concepts, investment processes, and documentation requirements into actionable specifications for technical teams.
Provide domain expertise to guide the development of AI models, document intelligence capabilities, structured data extraction, analytical tools, and intelligent workflows.
Work iteratively with engineers and data scientists to evaluate solution approaches, refine functionality, and improve the quality of outputs.
Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to operationalize private credit taxonomies within AI models, data extraction pipelines, validation frameworks, and downstream analytical workflows.
Assess the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and business relevance of AI-generated outputs, identify gaps, and work with technical teams to address them.
Help design scalable, reusable solutions that address common challenges across institutional clients rather than isolated client-specific requirements.
Participate actively throughout the development lifecycle—from initial concept and solution design through testing, validation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance existing capabilities and solve previously difficult or manual business problems.

Private Credit Domain Expertise & Taxonomy Development

Provide subject matter expertise across the private credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, structuring, execution, portfolio monitoring, and investment operations.
Apply a strong understanding of credit agreements, loan terms, financial covenants, debt structures, borrower financials, and investment documentation.
Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance comprehensive private credit taxonomies, covering financial and legal data points, credit agreement terms, covenant structures, and other investment-related attributes.
Define standardized data definitions, classifications, relationships, and business rules to ensure consistency and accuracy across document types, transactions, and clients.
Continuously evolve taxonomies to incorporate new deal structures, market conventions, client requirements, and emerging use cases.
Analyze complex financial and legal documentation to identify relevant data points, relationships, calculations, and analytical requirements.
Ensure solutions accurately reflect the nuances of private credit transactions and the practical needs of investment professionals.
Stay current with evolving private credit market practices, documentation standards, and industry developments.

Product Enhancement & Innovation

Bring client feedback, market insights, and domain expertise into the ongoing development and enhancement of Alphastream's platform.
Identify common requirements and emerging needs across client engagements that can be addressed through reusable product capabilities.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teams to evaluate new features and improve existing solutions.
Help ensure Alphastream's solutions remain differentiated, innovative, and aligned with evolving institutional client needs.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

3+ years of relevant experience in private credit, direct lending, leveraged finance, structured credit, or financial technology serving these markets.
Strong understanding of private credit investment processes, including credit analysis, deal structuring, documentation, and portfolio monitoring.
Practical familiarity with credit agreements, loan documentation, financial statements, covenants, and debt structures.
Demonstrated ability to engage with institutional clients or business stakeholders, understand complex challenges, and develop effective solutions.
Experience working with engineering, data science, or technology teams to design, develop, or enhance financial applications or data-driven solutions.
Ability to translate complex financial concepts and business processes into clear, actionable specifications for technical teams.
Ability to analyze complex private credit documentation and translate financial and legal concepts into structured taxonomies, standardized data definitions, and business rules.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to evaluate data quality, investigate discrepancies, define business rules, and validate solution outputs.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across business and technical disciplines.

Preferred

Experience at a leading private credit manager, alternative asset manager, investment bank, or specialized financial technology provider.
Prior experience in business analysis, solutions consulting, product development, or technology transformation within financial services.
Familiarity with AI/ML applications, large language models, document intelligence, workflow automation, and structured financial data platforms.
Experience collaborating with data scientists on AI model evaluation, validation, or performance improvement.
Experience developing or maintaining financial data taxonomies, data dictionaries, or standardized financial data models.
Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, data models, or analytical tools; hands-on programming experience is a plus but not required.
Understanding of institutional asset management systems and front-office, middle-office, and back-office workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Develop strong relationships with institutional clients and become a trusted resource for solving their private credit data and workflow challenges.
Independently translate complex business problems into well-defined solutions that engineering and data science teams can build and deliver.
Develop and continuously enhance robust private credit taxonomies that support accurate, consistent, and scalable data intelligence across the platform.
Work effectively with technical teams to improve the accuracy, reliability, scalability, and business relevance of AI-powered solutions.
Help deliver differentiated, industry-leading capabilities that materially improve client productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
Identify opportunities to transform client-specific requirements into reusable capabilities that benefit Alphastream's broader client base.

Why Alphastream?

This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation in private markets. Unlike traditional business analyst roles focused primarily on documenting requirements or supporting existing systems, this position combines direct engagement with some of the world's leading institutional investors with hands-on involvement in developing next-generation AI-powered financial technology. You will work alongside talented engineers, data scientists, and financial domain experts to solve some of the industry's most complex challenges—and help build solutions that redefine how private credit firms operate.

Order Management sits at the center of how Figma turns contracts into revenue — every deal our Sales team closes passes through this team before it's invoiced. As part of the Revenue Operations team within Accounting, we own order form review, invoicing, and billing support for Sales and Support for a global customer base. As Figma grows, we're building the order-to-cash process for what comes next, and this role is a builder's seat: you'll take on our most complex orders while helping shape how orders get processed, reviewed, and automated as we scale.

Detail-review routine orders processed by other analysts and our BPO partners, identifying error patterns and driving them to resolution
Play a key role in UAT for new products, SKUs, pricing models, and billing system releases — writing and executing test scripts, running end-to-end tests from order through billing, documenting bugs clearly, and working with cross functional partners to resolve

About The Role

This mid level analyst role will support the newly created No Surprises Act (NSA) actuarial team, with a strong focus on data management, analytics and process ownership. This role will assist in developing actuarial forecasts, reserves, financial analyses, and reporting related to federal NSA activity, while developing a strong understanding of NSA data sources and supporting data quality and reliability. The Actuarial Analyst II will partner across Actuarial, Finance, Operations, Legal, HNS and vendor teams to improve data collection and monitoring processes, assess emerging financial impacts, and communicate key results, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership.

Prepare analyses, summaries, and presentation materials that clearly communicate NSA financial results, emerging trends, key risks, and recommended areas of focus.
Participate in NSA working sessions and stakeholder meetings to understand operational changes, evaluate financial implications, and provide actuarial perspective on strategic initiatives.
Monitor regulatory, operational, and claims-related developments that may affect NSA financial results and communicate findings to actuarial leadership.

Understood is a nonprofit helping millions of people navigate the realities of neurodivergence. We translate trusted knowledge about ADHD, dyslexia, and dyscalculia into clear guidance, practical tools, and community support — so people don’t just feel informed, they feel understood.

Having a Shared Commitment To Our Values Is a Key Factor In Any Hire We Make. We Have Five Core Values

Continuously learn.

You're a hands-on data leader who gets energy from driving efficiency, improving delivery speed, and raising the bar for technical quality. You've built and operated production data pipelines and models yourself, but you know your highest leverage is setting direction, prioritizing effectively, and clearing roadblocks for your team. You're equally strong at coaching senior engineers toward broader ownership and developing early-career engineers' fundamentals. You challenge conventional thinking, helping engineers adopt more agile and iterative ways of working. Above all, you care deeply about ensuring the business has the reliable, timely, and actionable data it needs to succeed.

This is a hybrid role that requires a minimum of three (3) days a week in our NYC office, with a focus on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. We are a Mac-based environment, and team members are provided a Mac laptop for their work.

What you’ll do

Team leadership and development

Lead and grow the team. Manage a team of data and analytics engineers, from early-career to senior. Coach senior engineers toward broader ownership, build early-career fundamentals, and make sure every business domain has coverage.
Stay hands-on where it counts. Review code, pressure-test data models, and pair with engineers on hard problems while keeping your focus on direction, priorities, and clearing roadblocks.

Data delivery and operations

Own the health of our data. Oversee domain-level pipelines, models, and data contracts to maintain quality and SLAs across our stack: dbt, dlt, Snowflake, Fivetran, Monte Carlo, Omni, and GitHub.
Run the operational engine. Own the maintenance rotation, data quality alert triage, and intake of ad-hoc data requests from across the organization.
Be our data modeling expert. Identify the dbt features we're not using enough, optimize orchestration and build performance, and set best practices in modeling, testing, and CI/CD.

Strategy and partnership

Turn business needs into roadmaps. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize work, set milestones in Jira, and deliver on commitments.
Connect the dots across domains. Spot dependencies early and keep definitions, metrics, and documentation aligned across teams.

AI, eventing, and experimentation

Put AI to work in our workflows. Find where AI makes the team faster and more reliable. Maintain and improve the semantic layer that powers our self-serve and AI-assisted analytics.
Shape eventing and experimentation. Partner with Product and Engineering on event tracking design in Snowplow, and help evolve how we run A/B tests in Statsig.

Minimum Qualifications

In this role, you bring deep data expertise and the ability to own projects and workstreams end-to-end.

We don't expect a perfect match across every category. What matters is relevant experience, genuine interest in the work, and a mindset for growth

Leadership and people

Experience: 7+ years of experience operating on a data team. You have owned projects or workstreams end-to-end. You have experience leading small teams.
People leadership and development: You are responsible for coaching, feedback, and day-to-day management. You have 2+ years of demonstrated success in managing data teams, including teams with a mix of senior and early-career engineers.
Stakeholder and cross-functional partnership: You partner directly with other teams and build trust with partners through clear communication and reliable delivery, including a proven ability to partner directly with senior executives.

Strategy and execution

Domain expertise: Subject-matter expertise in data and analytics engineering, including experience with the modern data stack -- data modeling in dbt, testing, orchestration, and CI/CD -- and proficiency in SQL and Python.
Strategic thinking and execution: You own projects and workstreams, translate team priorities into plans for your team’s work.
Project management: You plan and run projects and workstreams end to end using project management tools like Jira. You can set milestones, manage risk, and coordinate the work of contributors, including prioritizing work, running maintenance rotations, triaging data quality incidents, and managing SLAs.

Communication, collaboration, and technology fluency

Communication: You communicate clearly with teammates, your manager, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners, adapting to the audience.
Collaboration and ways of working: You take ownership and deliver high-quality work, proactively identify improvements to processes or workflows, and balance technical oversight with stakeholder alignment.
AI fluency: You apply AI tools to improve output and efficiency within owned projects. You evaluate where AI adds value in the work and share good practices with the team.

Nice-to-haves

Familiarity with data governance for sensitive data, including PII handling and compliance frameworks such as HIPAA
Experience with A/B testing and experimentation platforms (we use Statsig)
Experience with event tracking and design on a platform like Snowplow

Develop and implement risk management strategies.
Monitor and report on risk levels and compliance with policies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risk impact.
Prepare comprehensive risk assessment reports for management.
Conduct regular risk audits and provide recommendations for improvement.

About Us:

Bounce
is a fintech startup revolutionizing debt recovery for consumers and creditors with our best-in-class product. By leveraging the power of AI and automation, we create user-friendly experiences that drive positive outcomes for all parties involved.
With a team based in Israel and New York, we have been growing rapidly. We support hundreds of thousands of consumers on their journey to financial resilience and build partnerships with top creditors and fintech companies.

How You’ll Spend Your Time:

Acquisition Underwriting

Evaluate incoming debt-sale opportunities by building loan-level and cohort-level collection and cash-flow forecasts and recommending bid pricing, expressed in cents on the dollar.
Stratify portfolios by product type, balance band, delinquency/age, state (statute-of-limitations exposure), and account attributes to understand what drives value.
Run seller data due diligence: completeness and fill rates, balance reconciliation to the tape, documentation/media availability, chain of title, bankruptcy/deceased scrubs, and prior placement history.
Build return models — IRR, MOIC, NPV/discounting, hurdle achievement — and stress-test the assumptions that matter most.
Translate underwriting assumptions into explicit, monitorable post-purchase expectations so we can later measure actual vs. underwritten.

Portfolio Surveillance

Track actual collection curves against underwritten curves by batch and vintage.
Maintain IRR/MOIC tracking against hurdle targets; flag underperformance early.
Partner with Data Science on estimated remaining collections (ERC) recalibration.
Diagnose return gaps by connecting them to operational drivers (outreach cadence, right-party contact, conversion, break/keep rates) and population factors (bankruptcy, bad contact data).
Produce recurring portfolio-risk reporting for leadership.

Building the Function

Help establish the risk playbook: underwriting standards, pricing methodology, monitoring cadence, and escalation thresholds.
Codify reusable analyses and write documentation for clarity and replicability.
Work with leadership to define risk appetite and the guardrails around it.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Proficiency in risk management software and tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Opportunity to grow in your career with a growing company

jobs.description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM is seeking an experienced Environmental Scientist III / Senior Environmental Scientist
to join our Environmental Remediation Practice in Richmond, California
.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and project coordination for environmental investigation, remediation, groundwater monitoring, compliance, and emergency response projects throughout Northern California and the western United States. This position will support a diverse portfolio of industrial, energy, transportation, municipal, and commercial clients while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams of scientists, engineers, geologists, and technical specialists.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing environmental field programs, coordinating subcontractors and laboratories, overseeing health and safety compliance, managing environmental data, and preparing technical and regulatory deliverables.

This position will be based in Richmond, California, with opportunities to support projects throughout Northern California and the western United States.

Responsibilities

Technical and Project Leadership

Lead environmental investigation, monitoring, remediation, and compliance projects from planning through execution.
Coordinate field schedules, staffing, subcontractors, laboratory services, equipment, and site logistics.
Develop and implement work plans, sampling plans, health and safety documentation, and project-specific field procedures.
Support project managers with project planning, budgeting, scheduling, resource forecasting, and client communications.
Identify project risks and develop solutions to achieve project objectives while maintaining quality, schedule, and budget commitments.

Groundwater Monitoring and Remediation

Plan and oversee groundwater, soil, sediment, and waste characterization programs.
Manage groundwater monitoring events and environmental sampling activities.
Coordinate remedial investigations, corrective action programs, groundwater treatment systems, and in-situ remediation efforts.
Evaluate environmental data and support development of remedial strategies and technical recommendations.
Ensure field activities are performed in accordance with project requirements and applicable regulations.

Environmental Compliance

Support environmental compliance programs for industrial, infrastructure, remediation, and construction projects.
Conduct environmental inspections, audits, and compliance assessments.
Monitor project activities for compliance with permits, mitigation measures, Environmental Protection Plans (EPPs), and Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs).
Coordinate with regulatory agencies, contractors, and stakeholders to support permitting and environmental compliance objectives.

Health and Safety

Implement and enforce site-specific Health and Safety Plans (HASPs), Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and company safety procedures.
Lead daily safety meetings, hazard assessments, and pre-task planning activities.
Support atmospheric monitoring, radiological monitoring, confined-space activities, and other specialized health and safety requirements.
Promote a strong safety culture through leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement.

Technical Reporting and Data Management

Prepare and review technical reports, groundwater monitoring reports, regulatory submittals, and field documentation.
Perform QA/QC reviews of environmental data, field records, and project deliverables.
Manage environmental databases and electronic reporting platforms, including EQuIS and GeoTracker.
Support data validation, interpretation, and presentation of technical findings to clients and regulatory agencies.

Team Development

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior environmental professionals.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including environmental scientists, geologists, engineers, biologists, technicians, and subcontractors.
Support staff development through field training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing initiatives.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Biology, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, or a related field and 4+ years environmental consulting or related professional experience (groundwater monitoring, environmental sampling, remediation field activities, and environmental compliance programs, leading project teams, coordinating complex environmental projects, experience preparing technical reports and regulatory deliverables, etc.) or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
A valid driver’s license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting California environmental remediation programs, including DTSC, RWQCB, and GeoTracker reporting requirements.
Experience at refinery, chemical, manufacturing, terminal, energy, or other industrial facilities, including CERCLA, RCRA, corrective action, and groundwater remediation programs.
Experience managing subcontractors, coordinating multidisciplinary project teams, and supporting emergency response and disaster recovery.
Experience with complex groundwater monitoring and reporting, environmental site investigations, remediation, compliance, and regulatory reporting.
Proficiency in EQuIS, GeoTracker, environmental database management, QA/QC, data validation, technical report preparation, SWPPP compliance, HASPs, JSAs, atmospheric and radiological monitoring.
Relevant training and certifications: current OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER, OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher, OSHA Site Supervisor Training, RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Training, Radiation Safety or Radiological Monitoring Training, Confined Space Entry Training, and First Aid/CPR Certification.

Additional Information

AECOM is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position.
Position may involve local and regional travel, field assignments, and periodic overnight travel.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What Makes AECOM a Great Place To Work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

Revolution Medicines is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, you will join other outstanding scientists in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Research Associate to support laboratory research activities focused on the development and execution of investigative toxicology (iTox) predictive assays and workflows to enable improved safety translation to the clinic. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the technical needs in a lab as well as significant hands-on experience with standard/bespoke cell culture and in vitro cell biology techniques. Further, the successful candidate will:

Develop novel approach methods (NAMs) including predictive 2D/3D models for nonclinical safety assessments.
Independently perform experiments related to in vitro/ex vivo 2D/3D assays using lab techniques that include cell viability/cell death, flow cytometry, primary cell culture, animal sample processing, molecular and cell isolation, immunofluorescence, plate-based reporter assays and ELISA/Luminex
Support in vivo study design, data analysis, study coordination and sample management
Analyze, interpret and accurately document assay/study results in an electronic lab notebook or other technical reporting formats
Work independently and collaboratively in a team to ensure timely and accurate data analysis and communication to support decision-making and contribute to high-quality study reports.
Support the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of lab instruments and contribute to the evaluation and adoption of new technologies for enhanced toxicity prediction, compound screening, and development of translational safety biomarkers.
Manage day-to-day experimental/study related activities in the lab and work effectively with Contract Research Organizations (CROs), RevMed study operations, internal scientists and subject matter experts (SMEs).
Maintain a safe and organized lab environment and support development and/or review of protocols, SOPs, policies, and guidelines.

Required Skills, Experience, and Education:

Bachelor/Master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related scientific discipline, with 5+ of relevant industry experience or 3+ years of postgraduate working experience.
Hands-on experience in operating and maintaining cell culture and standard lab instruments.
Experience maintaining lab environment, lab infrastructure and sample management.
Experience with animal sample processing and advanced cell culture techniques for immortalized cell lines, primary cells (including PBMCs) and/or iPSC cells.
Cell and molecular biology methods, including flow cytometry, Luminex/MSD, ELISA, cell viability/death assays.
Ability to conduct multiple laboratory and project tasks efficiently.
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment with flexibility.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, excellent record-keeping skills, and being able to adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills:

Experience working with small molecules and targeted oncology therapeutics of all modalities.
Experience working in a matrixed team environment at a biotech/pharma company or CRO.
3D assays, data analytics/ in silico experience is a plus.

### **Job Description and Duties**

Are you looking to be a part of a dynamic team of conservation-minded scientists working to protect fish and wildlife resources in the redwood and Douglas fir forests, oak woodlands, chaparral, and grasslands of the San Francisco Bay Area? The Department of Fish and Wildlife's Wildfire Resiliency Program is seeking a motivated professional to work as a Senior Environmental Scientist Specialist reviewing and evaluating vegetation management and fuel reduction projects, and Timber Emergencies and Exemptions by analyzing consequences of proposed activities, attending site visits and inspections, preparing written reports and recommendations for the conservation of fish and wildlife resources, assessing the application of law, regulation and policy, conducting listed and sensitive species consultations, and preparing any related Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreements and Incidental Take Permits.

The incumbent works in close collaboration with other Environmental Scientists and Senior Environmental Scientists, and with other state agencies. Under the direction of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory) the incumbent represents the region and acts as the staff lead and provides consultative advice when working with applicants, local, state and federal agencies, stakeholders, and the general public. Public contacts made in the course of this work are sensitive and involve a wide variety of special interest groups.

Performance of specified activities will require an in-depth knowledge of administrative procedures, Department policies, applicable environmental laws and regulations, and ecological principles to protect fish and wildlife resources. Strong written and oral communication skills are necessary. Problem-solving, organizational skills and a positive attitude towards teamwork are essential. Fieldwork in rugged terrain is required.  
  
  

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.
